padm--amidala--follow-my-lead.officialRules:
Padme’s leader ability still can be used as an action even if fewer than 2 friendly units entered play this phase (but you don't get to attack).
If you use Padme’s leader ability, you must attack with a unit, if able.
"When Attack Ends" abilities trigger at the same time the attacking unit deals combat damage. Padme does not need to survive the attack in order to attack with another unit.
Units that can’t attack bases can still damage bases through other abilities, like Overwhelm.
